status_vocabulary.SOURCED: Read from a named file or retrieved page whose SHA256 is recorded in sources.
status_vocabulary.DERIVED: Computed by the formula given; the calculator recomputes it and the tests compare.
status_vocabulary.ASSUMED: A planning value with the reason and what would source it. Never presented as sourced.

post_length_tol.reason: No post is selected; a turned standoff class value used for planning.

post_seat_tol.reason: Land plating and flatness under one post face; per face.

connector_standoff_tol.reason: Solder-joint height and coplanarity of one SMT connector half above its board.

bow_twist_ratio.note: Secondary attribution; the fabricator states <=0.5% as routine, not as a guarantee.

bow_model.value: kappa = 8 b / L; out-of-plane at distance d from the nearest fixing = kappa d^2 / 2 = 4 b d^2 / L
bow_model.reason: Uniform-curvature reading of a bow ratio b over the board's longest side L; fixings pull the board flat locally.
bow_model.to_source: Measured flatness of the received boards (first article)

bow_allocation.reason: Design allocation per board for residual bow at any pair; sets the fastener spacing.

strain_test_level.formula: 6 t delta / L^2 (three-point bend surface strain at mid-span) = 6 x 1.6 x 1.0 / 90^2

strain_safety_factor.reason: The test level is a pass condition, not a damage threshold; half of it is used as the design limit. The X5R/X7R parts on K have their own bending figures, not retrieved here.
strain_safety_factor.to_source: Design authority choice; bending specification of every ceramic part family fitted near the post rows

k_strain_model.value: fixed-guided beam: eps = 3 t Delta / s^2
k_strain_model.reason: K is held flat by posts and fasteners on each side of the span s; a relative offset Delta between the two clamped rows bends the strip between them.
k_strain_model.to_source: Plate FE model in ST-12 or strain-gauge coupon C-6

shim_resolution.reason: Residual Z after a measured shim or paired-nut take-up at P's panel-side fixings.
shim_resolution.to_source: Take-up hardware design (ST-12) and first-article measurement

smt_float_front.reason: Placement plus reflow float of a pegless SMT connector half, radial. S-JLC-PCBA states no placement accuracy.
smt_float_front.to_source: ST-01 footprint guidance; coupon C-2 measurement

smt_float_k.reason: As smt_float_front, for the K half.

pin_lean_deg.reason: Lean of a tall single-row stacker after reflow; tip offset = H tan(theta).
pin_lean_deg.to_source: ST-01 true-position or tip-coplanarity specification; coupon C-3 lean measurement

hole_position_tol_axis.note: Read as per axis relative to the board's copper image.

pth_hole_tol_plus.locator: 'Through-holes: +0.13 / -0.08 mm'; also 'Slot Hole size Tolerance Plated: +0.13 / -0.08 mm'

press_fit_hole_tol.locator: 'Press-fit holes: +/-0.05 mm (Finished hole size 0.55-2.0mm. Multilayer ENIG boards and circular holes only.)'
press_fit_hole_tol.note: Conditions: multilayer, ENIG, circular, named at order. JL/JR (6 layers), P and K qualify by layer count; the surface finish is not yet chosen; EL and O are two-layer and do not qualify.

routed_hole_position_tol_axis.note: Applied to the routed 7.0 mm selector aperture (above the 6.3 mm drill threshold in facts/jack.json); needs the precision option.

loc_pin_diameter.reason: Ground dowel pin class chosen for planning; within the 0.55-2.0 mm press-fit hole range.

loc_hole_clearance_precise.reason: Design choice: front-board round hole = pin + 0.06 in the press-fit tolerance class, so the minimum clearance is +0.01.

loc_slot_clearance.reason: Design choice: plated secondary slot width = pin + 0.10, so the minimum width clearance is +0.02 under the -0.08 slot tolerance.

r_loc_standard.formula: (0.10 + pth_hole_tol_plus + loc_pin_diameter.minus) / 2, a round hole of pin + 0.10 in the ordinary through-hole class

diag_pin_span_factor.reason: Recommended locating pins sit near opposite corners of each board's bounding box, 0.9 of its diagonal apart. ST-02 must find clear positions.
diag_pin_span_factor.to_source: ST-02 placement of the locating holes

th_lead_float.reason: Radial float of a through-hole jack, pot or toggle body in its drilled pattern before soldering; lead sizes are not retained.
th_lead_float.to_source: Lead dimensions from the drawings versus finished drill sizes; first-article axis measurement

boards.contents: The tallest stackers (12.9 mm pair) at 8 x 1x6 and 8 x 1x3 sites in two rows; 2 x 1x5 at the 6.9 mm height; two press-fit locating pins; four post lands of the ST-04 pattern with their screw holes; four 0603 MLCC footprints of the K families in line with the post rows, at 15 mm and 19 mm from the posts, each with a strain-gauge pad; daisy-chain copper through every contact; fiducials at each site

Matching low sockets; one round precise locating hole and one plated slot; four WQP518MA and four PTV09A footprints soldered by the same through-hole process beside the sockets; daisy-chain return copper; post lands. Variant CF-dX has its locating hole offset by X = 0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 or 0.5 mm along the pair rows to impose a known misalignment
Two 1x6 sockets at 17 mm pitch with collar-post holes at the EL tab spacing, to test seating with and without a backing platen

measurements.what: Mating and unmating force per position: force-displacement on a guided press, per pair width, at least 10 cycles
measurements.finishes: f and unmate_to_mate_ratio; screw and jacking loads

measurements.what: SMT float: optical coordinate measurement of each socket and stacker body against its fiducials after reflow
Reflow lean and standoff: tip true position of each stacker pin and housing height above board
Alignment yield: mate CF-dX variants and record first-pass mates, continuity of every daisy chain, and damaged contacts
measurements.finishes: a (the usable misalignment of the real pair, not only the catalogue figure)

measurements.what: Usable wipe: continuity of every chain while the post gap is raised in 0.05 mm shim steps from bottomed to open
measurements.finishes: w, the usable mated-height range used in the Z table

measurements.what: K strain: strain gauges at the MLCC sites while shims of 0.025 to 0.2 mm under one post row impose Delta; MLCC capacitance and cracking after
Through-hole process compatibility: inspect open sockets for flux and solder after the jack and pot soldering
EL seating (optional CE): deflection and strain at f with and without the backing platen
measurements.finishes: fr4_modulus for 0.4 mm and the EL seating method

st01_figures_needed.exact_need: Allowed mating misalignment, radial or per axis, for the 1x3, 1x5 and 1x6 pairs at each mated height (6.9, 7.2, 11.1, 12.9 mm), with the drawing locator
Mating force per position (maximum) and unmating force per position (minimum and maximum), with cycle condition
Mated-height tolerance of each pair (stacker post height tolerance plus socket seating)
Usable contact engagement (wipe) range: the gap interval over which every contact is made without bottoming
Pin true position or tip coplanarity of the tallest stacker after reflow (or the manufacturer's statement that none is given)
Housing coplanarity and seated height tolerance of each half
Whether a peg or hold-down option exists in the courtyard; this replaces the SMT float assumption
Pad or housing retention force under unmating load (for the 777-position jacking)
